gen-dafont-neon-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Glowing and vibrant, Neon draws each letter with one unbroken line width, like toothpaste squeezed steadily. And Atkinson Hyperlegible Next follows in a plain sans with big lowercase eyes and hooks left unlatched, so the glow gets a friendly landing.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-biryani: Vibrant and glowing, Neon stamps out tall lowercase forms with generous space between every pair of glyphs. Biryani takes over below with a large eye on each e and no thick-to-thin shifts, so paragraphs of it would feel unclogged and approachable.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-blinker: Neon-sign swagger, with tall stamped-metal lowercase and roomy spacing. Blinker has the quieter job: sans-serif lines that hold their thickness, open apertures, and lowercase filling most of the height, while Neon is the one built to glow.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-carrois-gothic: Carrois Gothic reads tall and open, its high x-height giving each c a generous mouth. Neon's diagonals match its horizontals in thickness, and that uniform glow against a plain sans below is the quality that holds the pair together.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Neon runs glowing, uninterrupted strokes with no hairlines to squint at, and its tall lowercase looks stamped from metal. Carrois Gothic SC does the opposite job, keeping every curve open and capitals nearly level with lowercase in a sans that stays contemporary.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-chivo: Steady-pressure glow, all tall stamped lowercase and open spacing. Neon does the attention-grabbing, while Chivo packs its lowercase up toward the caps and leaves visible daylight in every curve, which keeps the sans-serif text approachable.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-chocolate-classical-s: Neon's strokes never thin to hairlines, joining at full width. Chocolate Classical Sans answers with a sizable lowercase and a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut, a modern sans that lets the glowing heading lead.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-comme: Comme sets a smooth sans-serif read, with lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height and no clogged curves. But Neon is the one with glow, its rounded-nib strokes ending without any swelling and its stamped, tall lowercase spaced wide open.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-cossette-texte: Neon glows with uninterrupted line width and tall, stamped-metal lowercase, spaced generously throughout. Yet Cossette Texte keeps things clean below, its wide-eyed e and prominent x-height giving the sans-serif text a sturdy, readable footing.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-duru-sans: Glowing line, squeezed out in one steady stroke. Neon handles the vibrant display work, but Duru Sans handles the reading, a plain sans with wide openings on small letters and bodies that dominate while ascenders hardly show.
